projects.name: CashNews
projects.tagline: Fully automated AI-avatar news channel — daily short-form video published to YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok, plus a native iOS companion in progress.
projects.highlight: Pipeline: news fetch → script → TTS → avatar render → b-roll → publish. Zero human touch after topic prompt. The iOS app streams the daily drop and reads the underlying summary on the go.

projects.name: JobBoating
projects.tagline: Automated pipeline that tailors a resume per JD and submits applications end-to-end. Public funnel + browser-only tailor and tracker live on the site.
projects.highlight: 580+ applications submitted across 7 companies since 2026-07-04. In-browser: PDF → LaTeX conversion + keyword-matched tailoring against any JD, plus a localStorage application tracker.
